title: Add edit mode state and persistence hooks to MealPlanDetailView
description: Introduce local Edit mode and shared persistence helpers in `MealPlanDetailView` so block rename and reorder operations can update in-memory state and write the `.menu` document through the existing file path.
acceptance_criteria: The view has local state for Edit mode and single-alert rename staging.
A shared persistence path re-renders the updated `MealPlan` and writes it via `MealPlanFiles`.
Leaving Edit mode alone does not trigger a write.
The Edit control is disabled only when the plan has zero blocks.

handoff_summary.completed: Four state variables added (`isEditMode`, `pendingRenameBlockIndex`, `pendingRenameText`, `showBlockRenameAlert`). `persistPlan(_:)` centralises all in-memory + on-disk updates. `performBlockRename()` guards on valid index + non-empty text then delegates to `persistPlan`. Edit toolbar button (`.topBarTrailing`) toggles `isEditMode` and is `.disabled` when `plan.blocks.isEmpty`. Block rename `.alert` wired to staging state and `performBlockRename()`. Build succeeded.
handoff_summary.remaining: Sibling beads need to wire block-header long-press (or edit-mode affordance) to set `pendingRenameBlockIndex`/`pendingRenameText` and flip `showBlockRenameAlert`. Block reorder needs to call `persistPlan` from a drag-and-drop handler in `listContent`.
handoff_summary.risks: None. Changes are purely additive to existing view state; no existing behaviour is altered.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify the edit mode button toggles correctly, the Save button in the block rename alert is disabled on empty input, and that persisting a rename updates both the in-memory plan and the on-disk .menu file.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Sibling beads wiring block-rename triggers or block-reorder must read `pendingRenameBlockIndex`, `pendingRenameText`, `showBlockRenameAlert`, and `isEditMode` from this view — all added here and ready for use.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: `persistPlan(_:)` takes an explicit `MealPlan` argument (not mutating `plan` in place before calling) so callers always build the intended updated value and pass it atomically — avoids partial-update states. `performBlockRename` resets no state itself; the alert Cancel button clears staging state explicitly, keeping the alert vs. logic boundary clean.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Edit button disabled state, alert field empty-disable guard, and persist-on-rename (not on mode-toggle) are the three behaviours to exercise in tests.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Block reorder via `moveBlock(from:to:)` is not yet wired to `persistPlan`; that is out of scope for this bead and belongs to the reorder-UI sibling bead.

conflict_risks: Sibling beads wiring block-rename triggers or block-reorder must read `pendingRenameBlockIndex`, `pendingRenameText`, `showBlockRenameAlert`, and `isEditMode` from this view — all added here and ready for use.

execution_history.summary: Added edit mode state, rename staging state, a shared `persistPlan(_:)` helper, a `performBlockRename()` helper, an Edit/Done toolbar button (disabled when blocks is empty), and a block-rename alert to `MealPlanDetailView`. The persistence path updates in-memory `plan` and writes via `MealPlanFiles.writeText`. Toggling edit mode alone never calls `persistPlan`. Build verified clean.
